import openpyxl, os
p=os.environ['OUT_XLSX']
wb=openpyxl.load_workbook(p)
ws=wb.active
for r in range(2,7):
    ws.cell(row=r,column=1).value=f'=IF(B{r}<>"",COUNTA($B$2:B{r}),"")'
wb.save(p)
print('done')
